llm_fields.description: The scheme provides a monthly pension to registered building and construction workers who have paid subscriptions for at least three years and remain active in the profession until age 60.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicant must be a registered building/construction worker (unorganised worker), at least 18 years old, have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a year, have paid subscription fees for at least three continuous years, remain an active construction worker, be below 60 years of age, and not receive a similar pension from any other government scheme.
